title: Lazy Chainmail
description: A chainmail mod that revamps how chainmail is made!
body:
Lazy Chainmail is here to remedy the problem with most mods regarding chainmail -- the crafting table! No more putting chains, chainmail sheets, chainmail pads, or other items in the shape of armor. Instead, you can manually create wire, wind it up, snip the chains, and then add each chain to the final project! This is a stripped-bare version of Not Lazy Chainmail, only containing the essentials for making normal Chainmail armor.

Credit to [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/) for an easy-to-learn and easy-to-use mod-making system! :D
Join the Discord [here](https://discord.com/invite/ASkVBubyzH) for future updates on my mods!
For more information, visit the [wiki](https://anotherpedia.com/#Lazy%20Chainmail)!

![Winding Jig and Maille Crafting Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d390773439f36a551820d187983e9760507dd8a7.png)

For the full version of the mod, check out [Not Lazy Chainmail](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-lazy-chainmail)!
